hooks.command: echo '── web-safeguard ──' && git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/branch: /' && (test -d "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules" && echo 'node_modules: ✓ installed' || echo 'node_modules: ✗ MISSING — run npm install') && (test -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/prisma/schema.prisma" && echo 'prisma schema: ✓ present' || echo 'prisma schema: ✗ MISSING') && git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" status --short 2>/dev/null | head -10

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|mts)$' && [ -d "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules" ]; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx --no-install tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20 || true; fi

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|mts|jsx|js)$' && [ -d "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules" ]; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx --no-install eslint --fix "$FILE" 2>&1 | tail -10 || true; fi
FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE 'prisma/schema\.prisma$'; then echo '⚠️  schema.prisma changed — remember to run: npx prisma migrate dev'; fi
DIRTY=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$DIRTY" ]; then echo '⚠️  Uncommitted changes — consider committing before leaving:'; echo "$DIRTY" | head -10; fi
